items.source: Create a new ApplicationEvent with its timestamp set to System.currentTimeMillis().
items.translation: 创建一个新的ApplicationEvent，并将其timestamp设置为System.currentTimeMillis()。

items.source: source - the object on which the event initially occurred or with which the event is associated (never null)
items.translation: source - 事件最初发生或与之关联的对象（永远不会为`null`）

items.source: This constructor is typically used in testing scenarios.
items.translation: 此构造函数通常用于测试场景。

items.source: Create a new ApplicationEvent with its timestamp set to the value returned by Clock.millis() in the provided Clock.
items.translation: 创建一个新的ApplicationEvent，并将其timestamp设置为提供的Clock中由Clock.millis()返回的值。

items.source:
Class to be extended by all application events. Abstract as it
doesn't make sense for generic events to be published directly.
items.translation: 所有应用程序事件要扩展的类。由于泛型事件不能直接发布，因此将其设为抽象类。

items.source: Return the time in milliseconds when the event occurred.
items.translation: 返回事件发生时的毫秒时间。

items.source: clock - a clock which will provide the timestamp
items.translation: clock - 一个将提供时间戳的时钟。
